scenes.action: Hooni races into a sunny Australian kitchen, tummy rumbling, holding giant bag of frozen fries. Tracking camera.
Hooni stares at two air fryers. One has a single drawer, the other has two drawers. He tries to cram all his fries in a single drawer; slapstick bounce.

dialogue.text: Wait... why does this one have TWO drawers?

scenes.action: Pip floats in, projects a charming animation of cooking fries plus nuggets at the same time, then shows just one food cooking.

dialogue.text: Two drawers are handy for two foods. But do you actually need them?

scenes.action: Hooni tries to juggle nuggets and fries. Pip rescues a runaway nugget with a tiny grabber; they exchange goofy suspicious looks.

dialogue.text: I just want dinner, not a maths exam!

scenes.action: Pip gives the camera a deadpan look; Hooni comically steals a fry.

dialogue.text: Subscribe for our next kitchen disaster!
